search_record.judgement: No dominant public case for Republicans holding BOTH chambers was located. Every independent forecaster reached points the other way: Nate Silver's model gives Democrats roughly 86% for the House and roughly 57% for the Senate, and Cook rates the Senate map as favourable to Republicans while the House is not. The only located claim for the recorded side is RNC Chairman Joe Gruters', and it fails on three separate counts: it is political advocacy by an interested party rather than a forecast (standing ruling); the sole located report of it is dated 2026-01-17, eight months before posted_at, and is not a current case; and the claim that Republicans retain both chambers appears there only as the outlet's PARAGRAPH, not as his words, so it could not be quoted verbatim without the paraphrase §3 forbids. Nothing was reconstructed from the market's own question, price or structure (v1.12).
